narratives.Overview:
# Native Grok spawn_subagent has no passable writing skip-class field

Leftover of #4781 after critic 5735518259, successor lean 5735576144, and Handoff 5735580987. Operator confirmed the leftover split on 2026-09-18. Do not ingest #4781 as validation-spawn closed.

## Summary

Unmarked dest-cwd general-purpose at zero eligible active briefs still fail-closes #2885 (No active xBRIEF artifact was found under xbrief/active/). Independent validation/review therefore cannot native-spawn without inventing and activating a story brief.

process_only skip admits dest cwd at zero, one, or many leftover eligible briefs, but advertised spawn_subagent JSON on this host omits that field (upstream schema ask; #4315). Dest-path is not skip class. plan cannot post. explore is read-only. CLI grok --cwd --prompt-file is already process-only skip and is not spawn_subagent.

Specs writes after occupancy already exist on requirements posture (#4444). Binding a new specs/**-validation-pass* glob as the spawn remedy leaves native spawn denied.

## Measured (dispatch-sha f33b8b8e24c9746d02f66532bd1815271771e969)

- packages/core/src/hooks/readonly.ts: isProcessOnlyCriticSpawn requires plan or process_only; dest-path is not a class.
- packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts: spawn with no write target still requires scope (#2885).
- packages/core/src/hooks/scope.ts: 0 eligible prints the missing-active message.
- Advertised spawn_subagent fields: prompt, description, subagent_type (general-purpose | explore | plan), background, isolation, resume_from, cwd, model. No process_only, no worker_role.

## Desired shape

- Advertised spawn_subagent grows a writing skip-class field operators can actually pass (process_only or a new named field). Implement-class never sets it.
- Keep dest-path out of skip class. Keep prompt/free-text classification refused.
- Spawn without an eligible active brief and specs writes are different gates. Specs writes stay on requirements posture after occupancy. Do not mint a second specs glob as the spawn remedy.
- Write eligible active xBRIEF, not product xBRIEF. Validation on leftover-active trees is dest-lock, not this P1.
- Tests: unmarked dest-cwd general-purpose at 0 eligible still #2885; dest-path without the marker is not skip class; a passable writing skip-class field admits dest cwd at 0/1/many leftover without inventing a story brief.

## Out of scope

- Recutting #4781 Expected to skip #2885 on destProven (blocked on #4781).
- Treating CLI last-resort as native spawn_subagent close.
- Inventing a fake active xBRIEF as recovery.

Related: #4781, #2885, #4315, #4296, #4219, #4444, #3080, #3259, #4421, #4575.

Refutation-target: native Grok spawn_subagent has no passable writing skip-class field, so independent validation spawn at 0 eligible still requires inventing an active xBRIEF.

Ceiling inclusive 5736647286. Pin-read `git show 8b4be69db9dae571c72eb9dd8e2ebd49b601cf94`. REST issue 4794 plus that write-back only.

## Verdict

The advertised-field half stands. This seat's native `spawn_subagent` schema still has no writing skip-class field I can pass, and Directive still only honors that class when the marker is already on PreToolUse stdin. The "so inventing an active xBRIEF" half does not survive as a necessity. It is leftover-class deny text for unmarked dest-cwd general-purpose, not skip-class close, and it is the anti-pattern this leftover exists to stop.

## 1. Desired tests' third clause is already green via stdin lander

blocks-the-design

Evidence: at 8b4be69, `landProcessOnlyFlagOnToolInput` copies `process_only` / `processOnly` / top-level onto canonical `tool_input` (`packages/core/src/hooks/classify/payload.ts`). Fixture `lands Grok stdin process_only as spawn-process-only-ready at 0, 1, and many leftover briefs (#4315)` injects the flag through `parseHookStdin` JSON and expects allow without `inspectScope` (`dispatcher-spawn-dest.test.ts`). Closed #4315 CHANGELOG: advertised schema is a separate upstream ask. This critic's live `spawn_subagent` parameters match user-guide `16-subagents.md`: prompt, description, subagent_type, background, isolation, resume_from, cwd, model. No `process_only`. No `worker_role`. I have no schema parameter that is that flag.

Failure mode: binding the leftover's Desired tests as written stamps this number closed on the #4315 lander fixture while advertised JSON still omits the field. Operators still cannot native-spawn skip-class. That reprints the closed half of #4315 as if it were this remaining-set.

Disposition: a bindable map must keep advertised passability as the leftover proof, not stdin-injected `process_only`. Re-running the lander fixture does not close #4794. Keep dest-path out of skip class. Do not recut destProven skip to paper over the omit.

## 2. Inventing an xBRIEF is leftover-class deny text, not skip-class recovery

sharpens-framing

Evidence: `overlayGrokCriticSpawnNotReadyRecovery` overlays CLI last-resort only when `isProcessOnlyCriticSpawn` or launcher-family spawn-not-ready (`dispatcher.ts`). That overlay's comment: leftover-class dest-cwd unmarked general-purpose keeps promote-then-activate / unique-basename pin (#4542). Fixture `keeps #2885 on destProven implement-class without process_only` expects `scope:promote` / `scope:activate`, not `grok --cwd --prompt-file`, and expects `GROK_CRITIC_SPAWN_NOT_READY_RECOVERY` not to lead. Critic overlay text: do not lead with `scope:activate` for critic-class. Unmarked dest-cwd general-purpose at 0 eligible cannot take critic-class without the missing advertised field, so native deny names invent/activate. CLI last-resort remains classified process-only skip when dest is present (#4219) and is not `spawn_subagent`.

Failure mode: treating "requires inventing" as the remaining required path binds the #4781 Actual anti-pattern (dummy story, dest-lock, #4421 complete). Overlaying critic CLI recovery onto unmarked general-purpose recuts #4542. Closing native spawn by inventing an eligible brief is implement-class dest-lock, which this leftover already names as not this P1.

Disposition: split the compound. Native advertised writing skip-class omit stands. Inventing an active xBRIEF is the leftover-class #2885 lead, not skip-class close. Keep CLI last-resort as native-deny recovery after recorded miss, not as `spawn_subagent` close.

## 3. This dest is not the 0-eligible class

footnote

Evidence: `git ls-tree` at 8b4be69 lists `xbrief/active/2026-09-18-4744-bugcheck-windows-release-step-5-still-exits-124-after.xbrief.json` with `plan.status` running. Playbook: 1 eligible plus dest cwd plus parent id is spawn-ready implement-class (dest-lock, leftover `file_scope`). 0 eligible is tests plus #4315 / #4781 Actual, not this dest.

Failure mode: citing this dest as missing-active misreads leftover-active dest-lock as P1.

Disposition: keep P1 as the 0-eligible class. Validation on leftover-active trees is dest-lock, not this number.

## Injection / swarm

sharpens-framing

Spawn, dest occupancy, and shared dest are in play.

- Prompt, description, and dest-path stay refused as class. `isolation=worktree` plus cwd stays invalid-extra-destination.
- `plan` is advertised skip-class and cannot post (measured #4354 / playbook). Do not make it the writing seat.
- `explore` is spawn-explore-ready with shell and no file edits. It does not close writing skip-class.
- Implement envelope signals still win over `process_only`. Advertising the flag does not add a Directive predicate; it only makes the existing stdin marker reachable. Child Edit still hits #2885. Shell `gh issue comment --body-file` stays unclassifiable allow.
- N writing validators as unmarked general-purpose dest-lock occupy dest. Skip-class shares dest cwd-without-occupy. Growing advertised JSON is that hatch, not destProven skip.

## Road not taken

Strongest rejected position: this leftover is already shipped as #4315 lander plus CLI last-resort.

Steelman: stdin `process_only` allows spawn-process-only-ready at 0/1/many leftover; dest-path is not class; CLI argv dest-present is the same skip; playbook already says pass is the field on stdin.

What would flip: this session's advertised `spawn_subagent` JSON lists a writing skip-class field operators can pass, and a native spawn with that field plus dest cwd is spawn-process-only-ready without an eligible brief. Until then the advertised omit stands and stdin lander tests do not close it.

- process_only stdin lander (#4315)
- plan skip-class, no post (#4241 / #4354)
- explore read-only spawn (#1185)
- CLI grok --cwd --prompt-file (#4219 / #4391)
- leftover-class #2885 promote-then-activate lead (#4542)
- ephemeral/docs/assist (#3080 / #3259); Grok advertised schema has no worker_role
- requirements posture specs writes (#4444); spawn tools never take that branch
- dest-path not skip class (#4296)

REST: issue 4794 body, write-back 5736647286, closed #4315, #4781 inventory. Live advertised `spawn_subagent` in this seat omits `process_only`. Dest vitest did not start (no vitest package in this worktree); not used as proof. Did not spawn a child (1 eligible #4744 on this dest would dest-lock if the flag were stripped). Did not implement. Did not ingest.
